arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} While you have Vengeance, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadow every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds, {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction whenever you have at least {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} shadow, and Knockback Close enemies when you lose a shadow.
